name: GMK CYL Orange Alert
heroImageAlt: Four CYL-profile keycaps in a cluster, warm-grey line strokes with a coral-orange wash across two center alpha caps and small abstracted Katakana-style accent glyphs, evoking GMK CYL Orange Alert's industrial orange-beige-gray palette
description: GMK CYL Orange Alert — a Cherry-profile doubleshot ABS keycap set in GMK's Alert series, pairing an orange (GMK Orenji-matched), beige, and gray palette with Katakana accent legends for an industrial, technical look. Running August 14-September 14, 2026 across Divinikey, KBDfans, UniKeys, Keebz N Cables, and other regional vendors; estimated shipping February 2027.
